findings.binding: A54 S6 record-controlled label blinding; A47 I3 no row values printed/written
findings.cause: validate_case_block, load_manifest and producer_registry_from_obj interpolate unknown-key lists; _main catches Refused and prints str(exc) before the success-path blinding formatter.
findings.impact_limit: Synthetic input-label disclosure, not an observed scientific velocity disclosure and not an ADOPT_TAIL bypass. Successful report bodies passed the canaries.
findings.observed: Each invocation returns2 and prints the canary verbatim to stderr. No report is produced and no decision/adoption is made.
findings.recommendation: In either blinded mode, emit fixed refusal codes or allowlisted/redacted diagnostic fields at the common CLI error boundary. Apply the same rule to every preflight refusal; keep detailed raw input labels out of stderr.
findings.title: Blinded-mode early refusal diagnostics emit arbitrary numeric input labels
findings.trigger: Unknown key v_73.246813579 in a fresh case block, manifest, or producer registry; both --validity-only and --gates-only.
